change_summary: Changed the static grid tuple `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128),)` to a dynamic lambda `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),)` in kernel_function() so that autotune can properly control the grid size based on the selected XBLOCK config, enabling full SM utilization instead of the fixed 256-block grid that bypassed autotune.
